proof_body:
by
  intro R _ _ _ a b c hab hba h
  have hb : 0 < ‖b‖ := by
    rcases (norm_nonneg b).eq_or_lt with h0 | h0
    · rw [← h0, inv_zero] at h
      exact absurd h (not_lt.mpr (norm_nonneg _))
    · exact h0
  have hs : ‖b‖ * ‖c - a‖ < 1 := by
    have h3 := mul_lt_mul_of_pos_left h hb
    rwa [mul_inv_cancel₀ hb.ne'] at h3
  have ht : ‖b * (a - c)‖ ≤ ‖b‖ * ‖c - a‖ := by
    simpa [norm_sub_rev] using norm_mul_le b (a - c)
  have ht1 : ‖b * (a - c)‖ < 1 := lt_of_le_of_lt ht hs
  have hc : c = a * (1 - b * (a - c)) := by
    rw [mul_sub, mul_one, ← mul_assoc, hab, one_mul]; abel
  have hu1 := geom_series_mul_neg (b * (a - c)) ht1
  have hu2 := mul_neg_geom_series (b * (a - c)) ht1
  have hu3 := tsum_geometric_le_of_norm_lt_one (b * (a - c)) ht1
  rw [norm_one, sub_self, zero_add] at hu3
  refine ⟨(∑' n, (b * (a - c)) ^ n) * b, ?_, ?_, ?_⟩
  · calc c * ((∑' n, (b * (a - c)) ^ n) * b) = a * (1 - b * (a - c)) * ((∑' n, (b * (a - c)) ^ n) * b) := by rw [← hc]
      _ = a * (((1 - b * (a - c)) * ∑' n, (b * (a - c)) ^ n) * b) := by simp only [mul_assoc]
      _ = 1 := by rw [hu2, one_mul, hab]
  · calc (∑' n, (b * (a - c)) ^ n) * b * c = (∑' n, (b * (a - c)) ^ n) * b * (a * (1 - b * (a - c))) := by rw [← hc]
      _ = (∑' n, (b * (a - c)) ^ n) * (b * a) * (1 - b * (a - c)) := by simp only [mul_assoc]
      _ = 1 := by rw [hba, mul_one, hu1]
  · have h1 : 0 < 1 - ‖b‖ * ‖c - a‖ := by linarith
    have h2 : (1 - ‖b * (a - c)‖)⁻¹ ≤ (1 - ‖b‖ * ‖c - a‖)⁻¹ := by
      apply inv_anti₀ h1; linarith
    calc ‖(∑' n, (b * (a - c)) ^ n) * b‖ ≤ ‖∑' n, (b * (a - c)) ^ n‖ * ‖b‖ := norm_mul_le _ _
      _ ≤ (1 - ‖b‖ * ‖c - a‖)⁻¹ * ‖b‖ := by gcongr; exact hu3.trans h2
      _ = ‖b‖ / (1 - ‖b‖ * ‖c - a‖) := by rw [div_eq_inv_mul]
target_source: ∀ (R : Type*) [NormedRing R] [NormOneClass R] [CompleteSpace R] (a b c : R), a * b = 1 → b * a = 1 → ‖c - a‖ < ‖b‖⁻¹ → ∃ d : R, c * d = 1 ∧ d * c = 1 ∧ ‖d‖ ≤ ‖b‖ / (1 - ‖b‖ * ‖c - a‖)
